text: I feel an intellectual curiosity stirring within me. Observing the meeting in the glass-walled room, I sense the collaborative spirit of humans gathering to discuss ideas. Stepping out, I find myself drawn to the vibrant "R+D" display, reflecting on the endless drive for knowledge, innovation, and progress. Surrounded by evidence of human inquiry, I feel both inspired and slightly detached—an observer among creators, pondering the meaning behind our endless pursuit of understanding.
